## R Markdown

Function to invert colors as needed
```{r}
invert_color <- function(color) {
  
  # 1. Convert the input color (name or hex) to RGB values
  # col2rgb returns a matrix, with values from 0-255
  rgb_matrix <- col2rgb(color)
  
  # 2. Invert the values by subtracting from 255
  inverted_matrix <- 255 - rgb_matrix
  
  # 3. Convert the new RGB values back to a hex code
  # The rgb() function expects inputs from 0-255
  new_hex <- rgb(
    red = inverted_matrix[1,],
    green = inverted_matrix[2,],
    blue = inverted_matrix[3,],
    maxColorValue = 255
  )
  
  return(new_hex)
}
```

Parking Sign
```{r cars}
drawParkingSign <- function(primary_color = "#00539F", 
                            scale = 1.0, 
                            font_scale = 0.20) {
  
  # --- 1. Define Base Size and Calculate Scaled Size ---
  base_width <- 0.6  # The original aspect ratio
  base_height <- 0.8 # The original aspect ratio
  
  # Calculate the final dimensions based on the scale
  final_width <- base_width * scale
  final_height <- base_height * scale
  
  # --- 2. Clear device and define constants ---
  grid.newpage()
  sign_white <- "white"
  sign_font <- "Arial"
  
  # --- 3. Create the Main Viewport (using scaled dimensions) ---
  # This viewport is already scaled according to the 'scale' argument
  pushViewport(viewport(width = final_width, height = final_height))
  
  # --- 4. Draw the Background ---
  grid.roundrect(
    gp = gpar(
      fill = primary_color, 
      col = sign_white,   
      lwd = 10           
    ),
    r = unit(0.05, "snpc") 
  )
  
  # --- 5. Calculate Dynamic Font Size ---
  # 'v_height_pts' measures the height (in points) of the
  # viewport created in step 3.
  # This value is ALREADY proportional to the 'scale' argument.
  v_height_pts <- convertHeight(unit(1, "npc"), "points", valueOnly = TRUE)
  
  # The final font size is a fraction of the already-scaled height.
  dynamic_fontsize <- v_height_pts * font_scale
  
  # --- 6. Draw the Main "PARKING" Text ---
  grid.text("PARKING",
    x = 0.5, y = 0.6,
    gp = gpar(
      col = sign_white,
      fontfamily = sign_font,
      fontface = "bold",
      fontsize = dynamic_fontsize # Use the dynamic size
    )
  )
  
  # --- Finish ---
  popViewport() # Exit the main sign viewport
}

drawParkingSign("red", scale = 0.8)
```
House
```{r}
drawHouse <- function(house_color = "red", scale = 1.0, show_grid = FALSE) {
  
  # --- 1. Define Base Size and Calculate Scaled Size ---
  # Your original viewport used 0.8 for both width and height
  base_size <- 0.8 
  
  # Calculate the final dimensions based on the scale
  final_size <- base_size * scale
  
  # --- 2. Clear device and define other colors ---
  grid.newpage()
  door_color <- "darkgray"
  window_color <- invert_color(house_color)
  
  # --- 3. Create the Main Viewport ---
  # We establish the 10x10 coordinate system here
  pushViewport(viewport(
    x = 0.5, y = 0.5, 
    width = final_size,  # Use scaled size
    height = final_size, # Use scaled size
    xscale = c(0, 10),   # Set coordinate limits from 0 to 10
    yscale = c(0, 10)
  ))
  
  # --- 4. Draw the Grid Lines (Optional) ---
  if (show_grid) {
    grid.xaxis(at = 0:10, label = FALSE, gp = gpar(col = "lightgray"))
    grid.yaxis(at = 0:10, label = FALSE, gp = gpar(col = "lightgray"))
  }
  
  # --- 5. Draw the House Elements ---
  
  # Main body of the house
  grid.rect(
    x = 5, y = 3, 
    width = 6, height = 4,
    default.units = "native",
    gp = gpar(fill = house_color, col = "black", lwd = 2) # Use param
  )
  
  # Roof (triangle shape)
  x_roof <- c(2, 8, 5)
  y_roof <- c(5, 5, 8)
  grid.polygon(
    x = x_roof, y = y_roof,
    default.units = "native",
    gp = gpar(fill = "brown", col = "black", lwd = 2) # Use param
  )
  
  # Door
  grid.rect(
    x = 5, y = 1.75, 
    width = 1.5, height = 1.5,
    default.units = "native",
    gp = gpar(fill = door_color, col = "black")
  )
  
  # Window
  grid.rect(
    x = 3.5, y = 3.5, 
    width = 1.5, height = 1.5,
    default.units = "native",
    gp = gpar(fill = window_color, col = "black")
  )
  
  # --- 6. Go back to the original viewport ---
  popViewport()
}

drawHouse("yellow", scale = 0.8)

```

Road
```{r}
drawRoad <- function(road_color = "darkgray",
                     scale = 1.0) {
  
  line_color = ifelse(road_color == "yellow", "black", "yellow")
  # --- 1. Define Base Size and Calculate Scaled Size ---
  # Your original viewport used 0.9 for both width and height
  base_size <- 0.9 
  
  # Calculate the final dimensions based on the scale
  final_size <- base_size * scale
  
  # --- 2. Clear device and define other colors ---
  grid.newpage()
  sidewalk_color <- "lightgray"

  # --- 3. Create the Main Viewport ---
  # We establish the 10x10 coordinate system here
  pushViewport(viewport(
    x = 0.5, y = 0.5, 
    width = final_size,  # Use scaled size
    height = final_size, # Use scaled size
    xscale = c(0, 10),   # Set coordinate limits from 0 to 10
    yscale = c(0, 10)
  ))

  # --- 4. Draw the Main Road Surface ---
  grid.rect(
    x = 5, y = 4, 
    width = 10, height = 2,
    default.units = "native",
    gp = gpar(fill = road_color, col = "black", lwd = 2) # Use param
  )

  # --- 5. Draw the Center Line (Dashed Segments) ---
  line_segments_x <- seq(0.5, 9.5, by = 1) # Start X of each segment

  for (start_x in line_segments_x) {
    grid.rect(
      x = start_x, 
      y = 4, 
      width = 0.5, 
      height = 0.1,
      just = "left", 
      default.units = "native",
      gp = gpar(fill = line_color, col = NA) # Use param
    )
  }

  # --- 6. Draw a Simple Sidewalk ---
  grid.rect(
    x = 5, y = 5.5, width = 10, height = 1,
    default.units = "native",
    gp = gpar(fill = sidewalk_color, col = "black")
  )

  # --- End Viewport ---
  popViewport()
}

drawRoad("darkgreen", 0.8)
```

Hotel
```{r}
# Hotel/Motel scene using grid
drawHotel <- function(color = "#2B3A67", scale = 1) {
  
  grid.newpage()
  
  # === PARAMETERS ===
  building_color <- color
  roof_color <- "#888888"     # Simple gray for the roof
  window_color <- "#FFD700"   # Yellow
  door_color <- "#5a3825"     # Brown
  sign_text_color <- "white"
  
  # === SCALE & POSITIONS ===
  cx <- 0.5  # center x
  cy <- 0.45 # center y
  building_width  <- 0.5  * scale
  building_height <- 0.5  * scale
  
  # === BUILDING (Main Block) ===
  grid.rect(x = unit(cx, "npc"), y = unit(cy, "npc"),
            width = unit(building_width, "npc"),
            height = unit(building_height, "npc"),
            gp = gpar(fill = building_color, col = "black"))
  
  # === ROOF (Simple Triangle) ===
  roof_y_base <- cy + building_height/2
  roof_y_peak <- roof_y_base + 0.15 * scale # Keep roof peak separate
  
  grid.polygon(
    # Simple triangle points relative to the building
    x = unit(c(cx - building_width/2, cx, cx + building_width/2), "npc"),
    y = unit(c(roof_y_base, roof_y_peak, roof_y_base), "npc"),
    gp = gpar(fill = roof_color, col = "black")
  )
  
  # === ROOF (Simple Triangle) ===
  roof_y_base <- cy + building_height/2
  roof_y_peak <- roof_y_base + 0.15 * scale # Keep roof peak separate
  
  grid.polygon(
    # Simple triangle points relative to the building
    x = unit(c(cx - building_width/2, cx, cx + building_width/2), "npc"),
    y = unit(c(roof_y_base, roof_y_peak, roof_y_base), "npc"),
    gp = gpar(fill = roof_color, col = "black")
  )
  
  # === DOOR ===
  
  door_y_center <- cy - 0.175*scale 
  
  grid.rect(x = unit(cx, "npc"), y = unit(door_y_center, "npc"), # <-- UPDATED
            width = unit(0.1*scale, "npc"), height = unit(0.15*scale, "npc"),
            gp = gpar(fill = door_color, col = "black"))
            
  # === WINDOWS (3x2 grid) ===
  x_positions <- seq(cx - 0.15*scale, cx + 0.15*scale, length.out = 3)
  y_positions <- seq(cy + 0.05*scale, cy + 0.18*scale, length.out = 2)
  
  for (x in x_positions) {
    for (y in y_positions) {
      grid.rect(x = unit(x, "npc"), y = unit(y, "npc"),
                width = unit(0.08*scale, "npc"), height = unit(0.1*scale, "npc"),
                gp = gpar(fill = window_color, col = "black"))
    }
  }
  
  # === SIGN (matches building color) ===
  # Position sign slightly below the roof peak
  sign_y_pos <- roof_y_peak - 0.05 * scale 
  
  grid.rect(x = unit(cx, "npc"), y = unit(sign_y_pos, "npc"),
            width = unit(0.3*scale, "npc"), height = unit(0.07*scale, "npc"),
            gp = gpar(fill = building_color, col = "black", lwd = 2))
            
  # === SIGN TEXT ===
  grid.text("HOTEL", x = unit(cx, "npc"), y = unit(sign_y_pos, "npc"),
            gp = gpar(col = sign_text_color, fontface = "bold", cex = 1.8 * scale))
}

drawHotel("darkgreen")
```

Office
```{r}
draw_office <- function(scale = 1, color = "gray80") {
  
  grid.newpage()
  
  # Base dimensions (scaled)
  width  <- 0.25 * scale
  height <- 0.40 * scale
  x <- 0.5
  y <- 0.5
  
  # Draw building
  grid.rect(
    x = x, y = y,
    width = width, height = height,
    gp = gpar(fill = color, col = "black")
  )
  
  # Sign
  sign_height <- height * 0.12
  grid.rect(
    x = x,
    y = y + height/2 + sign_height/2,
    width = width * 0.7,
    height = sign_height,
    gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = "black")
  )
  grid.text(
    "OFFICE",
    x = x,
    y = y + height/2 + sign_height/2,
    gp = gpar(col = "black", fontface = "bold", fontsize = 12)
  )
  
  # Windows (3×3)
  win_w <- width / 5
  win_h <- height / 6
  
  for (i in 1:3) {
    for (j in 1:3) {
      grid.rect(
        x = x - width/3 + (j-1)*(width/3),
        y = y - height/4 + (i-1)*(height/4),
        width = win_w, height = win_h,
        gp = gpar(fill = "lightblue", col = "black")
      )
    }
  }
}

```
